title: Keep one user's grants from reaching everyone with the same role

blocks.text: The document service checks every request against the user's grants: the base grants of their role, plus extra grants an owner gave them, which are stored in the `extra_grants` column as the grants' names separated by commas (`COMMENT,SHARE`). Support has two tickets open. Since Monday's release, every editor can share documents, although only one editor was ever given that right. And the members page fails to open for any user with no extra grants at all.
The role table in `src/main/java/practice/Grants.java` is right. Finish its three `TODO`s:

items: `base(...)`: a role's base grants, as handed to the rest of the service;

blocks.text: When you're done, nothing a caller does with the sets it receives, and no user's grants, change what a role grants, and every value in the column reads back. About ten lines in total.

cases.says: each role reports its base grants
a user's grants are the role's base grants plus the extra ones
a stored list of names reads back as those grants
a caller that tries to add to a role's grants does not change what the role grants
computing one user's grants leaves the role's base grants unchanged
an empty stored value reads back as no grants, without an exception

origin.section: EnumSet Is a Typed Bit Mask, and a Shared One Must Be Unmodifiable

concepts: EnumSet.copyOf(Collection) throws IllegalArgumentException on an empty collection that isn't an EnumSet; noneOf plus addAll handles the empty case.
A static final EnumSet is still mutable: a caller that adds to it, or a union built on it in place, changes it for every user; shared sets are wrapped unmodifiable and per-user sets are copies.
